title: Scrum Bind Tight In Portuguese (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar fiddle portuguese samba accent
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, I am going to teach the scrum today
In Portuguese
I do not speak Portuguese
But Brazil plays rugby now
And Argentina has always played rugby
So there must be something to it

[Verse 1]
Bind tight to the jersey not the arm
Hips level, back straight, do no harm
Drive low and forward as one unit
Scrum bind tight, there is nothing to it

[Portuguese Verse]
Segurar firme na camisa nao no braco
Quadris nivelados, costas retas, o passo
Empurrar baixo e para frente como um
Scrum firme e unido, assim se faz o brum

[Chas reacts spoken]
Now I do not speak Portuguese son
But I understand every word of that
Bind to the jersey, hips level, drive as one
The Brazilians and Argentinians have it right

[Chorus]
Scrum bind tight push as one
Segurar firme, empurrar o brum
Hips level, back flat, drive low
Scrum bind tight, there you go

[Verse 2]
The front row binds first, then the locks arrive
Flank and eight man slot in behind to drive
Eight bodies working as one machine
Scrum bind tight, the tightest team

[Portuguese Bridge]
A primeira fila primeiro, depois os fechadores
Flank e oito por tras, todos os melhores
Oito corpos como uma maquina unida
Scrum firme e junto, essa e a vida

[Chas spoken]
Eight as one son
Oito como um
Same in any language

[Chorus]
Scrum bind tight push as one
Segurar firme, empurrar o brum
Hips level, back flat, drive low
Scrum bind tight, there you go

[Outro]
Oito como um, meu filho
Eight as one son
Thats my boy
